market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver reaching $120/oz by mid-2026 would require a >4x rally from current levels (~$30) in just over a year, a move that has never occurred in modern history and is unsupported by fundamentals. The all-time high is near $50, and even extreme bullish scenarios rarely target triple digits. Therefore the true probability is far below the market’s implied 6.8%, making 'No' heavily undervalued.
evidence_points: Silver’s all‑time settlement high was ~$48.70 in 2011; a move to $120 would shatter that record by 150% without an obvious catalyst.
CME Active Month settlement price must close at or above $120 on a trading day, leaving no room for intraday spikes; daily settlement gaps of this magnitude are historically absent.
Even in hyper‑inflation or severe supply‑shock narratives, silver prices are constrained by industrial demand elasticity and substitution effects, making a 4x jump in ~18 months extremely improbable.
sources_consulted: World Gold Council & Silver Institute long‑term price outlooks
